routes.retired_because: The formal growth values A(x)=B(x)=sqrt(x/log x) satisfy the necessary counting bounds and prime-coverage product bound simultaneously.

C9000013.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 013 (Ostmann’s inverse Goldbach conjecture.; papers: The additive indecomposability of the primes; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/013.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_OSTMANN.statement: For every A,B subset N_0 with at least two elements each, (A+B) symmetric-difference P is infinite.

C_FINITE.statement: An eventual decomposition of the positive primes into two nontrivial subsets of N_0 has both summands infinite.

C_TWO_INFINITE.statement: No two infinite subsets of N_0 have sumset of finite symmetric difference from the positive primes.

C_COLLISION.statement: Under the hypothetical eventual decomposition, the weighted collision-stability inequality of lem:collision holds for the stated tail measures and point-mass bound.

C_QUADRATIC.statement: The independently translated quadratic-character correlations in prop:quadratic have weighted prime-band average o(T).

C_CHARACTERS.statement: For every fixed 0<alpha<beta, prop:characters bounds the harmonic-band maximum translated correlation over all character orders greater than two by o(L).

C_FLAT.statement: The centered normalized additive transforms g_p in cor:mixed-flatness have uniformly vanishing mixed-character correlation outside harmonic prime mass o(L).

C_SUPPLY.statement: There is an absolute delta_0>0 for which the balanced primes with gamma_p>=delta_0 in the stated harmonic band have mass at least 0.15L for all sufficiently large L.

C_ARITH.statement: The diagonal and signed history bounds of prop:comparisons hold uniformly over their allowed arithmetic environments and assignments.

C_TRANSFER.statement: The constructed transfer amplitudes satisfy the lower recurrence and final lower bound in Section 09.

C_FINAL.statement: The final permutation-symmetrized upper bound contradicts the transfer lower bound after choosing depth and then scale.

C_TREE.statement: For every odd prime and every literal permitted diagram, the single second moment is at most 3^r and the paired correlation is at most C_l(epsilon+q^(-1/4)) whenever l>=2 and b<=3r/4.
C_TREE.remaining_obligation: Independent review of the complete all-field proof; Engineer support is not Reviewer certification.

C_TREE_DENSITY.statement: At every horizontal level, the valid argument law is dominated by 2^(k-1) times independent uniform unit measure, for k nodes at that level.

C_TREE_MAJORANTS.statement: Quartet Mellin coefficients admit nonnegative majorants depending only on the parent argument, g, q, and the character, with small supremum of means O(epsilon^2+q^(-1/2)) and bounded sum of means, uniformly over ancestor data and parameters.

C_TREE_AFFINE.statement: The uniform Mellin estimate eq:src42 holds for every character eta and additive frequency a, with bound q/(q-1)*(epsilon^4+sqrt(3)*q^(-1/2)).

C_TREE_FOURTH.statement: The nonprincipal Gauss-convolution fourth moment and principal correction give the two-bad twisted-convolution bound O(epsilon^2+q^(-1)).

C_TREE_CYCLE.statement: A cycle preserving component and quartet products yields the required projected norm estimate, including a two-parallel-edge cycle.

C_TREE_ALGEBRA.statement: The reconstruction identities, square-root fiber dichotomy, nonidentity affine fiber injectivity, and off-diagonal quadratic-collision uniqueness hold over every field with their stated nonzero hypotheses.
C_TREE_ALGEBRA.remaining_obligation: The formal algebra has a real zero-hole compiler certificate; independent statement-fidelity review remains.
